reports.title: ODDITY TECH REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AHEAD OF PLAN, RAISES FULL YEAR NET REVENUE AND ADJUSTED EBITDA OUTLOOK

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: ODDITY is raising net revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance for the full year ending December 31, 2026:

· | Net revenue to decrease by approximately 18.5% year-over-year
· | Adjusted EBITDA between $32 million and $34 million

Current FY2026 Outlook | Prior FY2026 Outlook
Net Revenue | -18.5% | -19.0%
Adjusted EBITDA | $32 to $34 million | $30 to $32 million
ODDITY is providing the following guidance for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026:

· | Net revenue to decrease by between 10% and 11% year-over-year
· | Adjusted EBITDA between $4 million and $6 million

desk.headline: Revenue down 2% to $145.0m, beat; full-year revenue and EBITDA outlook raised
results: Net revenue slipped 2% to $145.0m, better than the company's forecast of a 5% fall and a big improvement on Q2.
Adjusted EBITDA of $22.0m beat its $18–20m outlook but was down from $28.9m a year ago.
Gross margin fell to 67.4% from 71.6%; net income dropped to $11.2m from $17.7m.
SpoiledChild grew strongly and is on track for at least 35% growth this year; newer brand METHODIQ kept growing.
Cash and investments stood at $561m; about $86m is left under the $200m buyback plan.

guidance.summary: ODDITY now expects 2026 revenue to fall about 18.5% (was 19%) and adjusted EBITDA of $32–34m (was $30–32m). For Q4 it sees revenue down 10–11% and adjusted EBITDA of $4–6m.

points: The IL MAKIAGE slump stems from an algorithm problem at its biggest ad partner, which is still not fixed.
Customer acquisition costs improved in September but weakened again in October; management called the trend very volatile.
Lower order values drove the gross margin drop; pressure is expected to ease in 2027, but no figure was given.
METHODIQ plans to add prescription injectable and peptide therapies in 2027, alongside a fourth brand launch.
Buybacks have cut shares outstanding by about 20% this year; no 2027 guidance was given, but the aim is growth across all brands.
call.source: Q3 2026 call transcript — Nasdaq (Motley Fool), 11 Nov 2026

watch: Whether the advertising problem at IL MAKIAGE is resolved and new-customer costs settle.
Gross margin and the run-down of excess IL MAKIAGE inventory.
Early take-up of METHODIQ's peptide therapies and the new brand in 2027.
